name: vt-prefix-mid-sequence

graded_by.test: owed by the E2 core plan
owed by the E2 vt plan

description: The attach prefix when the parser is not at ground (F8; C4 decision 6): if the parser is not at ground when prefix is requested and no ground point arrives within a short wait (a knob), the VT answers with through_seq equal to the last frame applied and appends, after the dump, the raw output bytes since the last ground point — so the client's parser ends in the same mid-sequence state and there is no 4011 loop. In the at-ground case through_seq is a ground point (vt-prefix-at-ground); here it is not, and the appended raw bytes ride the kind-3 blob after prefix_ready and are not listed here. After hello, the grid's open and the frames, the core requests prefix and the VT answers prefix_ready with the same request_id. Graded by the U4 worker (owed) and the U2 core (owed).
